# Tao v0.1.0-beta.1

This is Tao's first public beta. Tao helps you turn an LLM-assisted plan into small, reviewable slices, run each slice in an isolated Git workspace, verify and review the result, and then integrate approved work.

## What you can try

- Plan and slice work with managed prompts for Pi or Claude Code.
- Validate and approve plans before an agent changes the repository.
- Run slices individually or through a durable queue with safe interruption recovery.
- Review completed diffs, apply bounded automatic rework, and act on GitHub pull-request feedback.
- Finish through either a Tao-managed pull request or a verified local merge.
- Monitor plans across repositories with `tao monitor` or the interactive `tao ui` dashboard.
- Capture repository notes, export sanitized plan reports, and inspect bounded workflow insights.

## Install the beta

Download the archive for your platform from the assets below, then verify it against `checksums.txt` before extracting it:

- `tao_0.1.0-beta.1_darwin_arm64.tar.gz`
- `tao_0.1.0-beta.1_darwin_amd64.tar.gz`
- `tao_0.1.0-beta.1_linux_arm64.tar.gz`
- `tao_0.1.0-beta.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz`

For example:

```sh
shasum -a 256 -c checksums.txt --ignore-missing
tar -xzf tao_0.1.0-beta.1_<os>_<arch>.tar.gz
./tao version
```

Move the extracted `tao` binary to a directory in your `PATH`, then install the managed agent prompts and inspect your setup:

```sh
tao install-prompts
tao doctor
```

## Beta limitations

- Beta releases are available from GitHub only. Homebrew publication and `tao update` remain stable-release channels and will not install this beta.
- Release binaries support macOS and Linux on AMD64 and ARM64; Windows is not currently supported.
- Tao is CLI-only and stores plans, notes, queue state, reviews, and telemetry locally under its data home.
- Agent workflows require at least one supported agent executable with its own authentication configured.
- Pull-request creation and pull-request feedback rework currently target GitHub repositories.

Please report bugs and workflow feedback through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/iamseth/tao/issues/new/choose). Include `tao version`, your platform, the selected agent, and a sanitized reproduction when possible.
